title: spesim package review (teaching + method-testing focus)
text: spesim’s core strengths () coherent “simulate → sample → analyse” pipeline irregular domains, (ii) excellent teaching ergonomics (init files, clear vignettes, stable API guidance), (iii) good alignment canonical community-ecology diagnostics. main weaknesses typical deliberately lightweight simulator: models heuristic rather mechanistic; domain/units synthetic default; several outputs can misinterpreted “process inference” unless users read model card. 0.3.3 audit layer (nearest-neighbour diagnostics, filtering checks, sampling rejection/exclusion summaries) strong step toward turning spesim “tutor audits user’s conceptual model”.

text: Rank–Abundance (SAD) — Observed vs. theoretical Fisher log-series. Occupancy–Abundance — Total abundance vs. number occupied sites. title: Quadrat placement schemes in spesim
text: Use : want simple random sampling don’t want quadrats overlapping. Mechanics: rejection sampling random centres (uniform shrunk bounding box), accepting quadrats fully inside domain overlap already accepted quadrats.  Notes: domain small quadrats large, may get fewer quadrats requested (warning). often good default teaching.
code: set.seed(2) q_random <- place_quadrats(domain, n_quadrats = 20, quadrat_size = quadrat_size) plot_quadrats(domain, q_random, "Random placement (non-overlapping)")

title: Quadrat placement schemes in spesim
text: Use : want quadrats drawn regular tiling, strict non-overlap. Mechanics: regular grid cells (st_make_grid) quadrat size created; tiles fully inside domain candidates; n_quadrats sampled candidates.  Notes: Returned quadrats never overlap. domain narrow “necks”, many grid cells may excluded.
code: set.seed(3) q_tiled <- place_quadrats_tiled(domain, n_quadrats = 20, quadrat_size = quadrat_size) plot_quadrats(domain, q_tiled, "Tiled placement (grid cells inside domain)")

title: Quadrat placement schemes in spesim
text: Use : want regular lattice quadrats (systematic sampling). Mechanics: centres placed nx × ny grid spanning domain bounding box; quadrats centred points retained fit entirely domain.  Notes: actual number returned may differ n_quadrats grid filtered domain boundary. Quadrats may overlap grid spacing smaller quadrat size (depends inferred grid density).
code: set.seed(4) q_systematic <- place_quadrats_systematic(domain, n_quadrats = 25, quadrat_size = quadrat_size) plot_quadrats(domain, q_systematic, "Systematic placement (regular lattice)")

title: Quadrat placement schemes in spesim
text: Use : want transect-based sampling (parallel lines across domain) evenly spaced quadrats along transect. Mechanics: n_transects parallel lines created across safe area (domain shrunk half quadrat diagonal). Along transect segment, n_quadrats_per_transect quadrats placed.  Notes: quadrats remain axis-aligned, even transects run angle. safe area becomes small (large quadrats, narrow domain), quadrats may returned.
code: set.seed(5) q_transect <- place_quadrats_transect(   domain,   n_transects = 2,   n_quadrats_per_transect = 8,   quadrat_size = quadrat_size,   angle = 60 ) plot_quadrats(domain, q_transect, "Transect placement (2 transects, angle = 60°)")

title: Quadrat placement schemes in spesim
text: Use : want sampling locations well-spaced complex domains. Mechanics: dense set random seed points placed domain; Voronoi tessellation computed; cells screened whether can contain quadrat (based inscribed circle heuristic). Quadrats placed cell centres.   Notes: narrow irregular domains, increase voronoi_seed_factor (computational cost). current implementation focuses finding feasible, nicely spaced sites; designed guarantee strict non-overlap cases (though overlap uncommon moderate sizes).
code: set.seed(6) # Note: very large voronoi_seed_factor values tend to create many small cells, # which can make it impossible to fit larger quadrats. If you get an empty # result, either reduce `voronoi_seed_factor` or use a smaller quadrat_size. q_voronoi <- place_quadrats_voronoi(   domain,   n_quadrats = 20,   quadrat_size = c(1.2, 1.2),   voronoi_seed_factor = 4,   show_voronoi = TRUE )  # Standard view (domain + quadrats) plot_quadrats(domain, q_voronoi, "Voronoi placement (seed_factor = 4; size = 1.2×1.2)") # Optional: show the underlying Voronoi tessellation used to select candidates vor_cells <- attr(q_voronoi, "voronoi_cells")  seeds <- attr(q_voronoi, "voronoi_seeds")  p_voronoi_diag <- ggplot() +   geom_sf(data = domain, fill = NA, colour = "#22223b", linewidth = 0.7) +   geom_sf(data = vor_cells, fill = NA, colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.5) +   geom_sf(data = sf::st_as_sf(seeds), colour = "grey40", alpha = 0.7, size = 0.8) +   geom_sf(data = q_voronoi, fill = "#4a4e69", alpha = 0.18, colour = "#22223b", linewidth = 0.6) +   coord_sf(datum = NA) +   labs(title = "Voronoi diagram (clipped) + seeds + selected quadrats") +   theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +   theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())  print(p_voronoi_diag)
